newsitem.title: USA: Capital Re, GCR Holdings team up.
newsitem.headline: Capital Re, GCR Holdings team up.

text.p: Capital Re Corp and GCR Holdings Ltd said Tuesday they have formed a joint venture company, Capital Global Underwriters Ltd, that will specialize in financial reinsurance.
The joint venture is to be based in Bermuda. The companies said it will be organized with up to $50 million of committed capital to be provided equally by Capital Re and GCR.
GCR President and Chief Executive Lawrence Doyle said in a statement that the venture would enhance GCR's efforts to diversify beyond the property catastrophe business.

Capital Re Chairman, President and Chief Executive Michael Satz said in a statement that the venture provides the company with the ability to use a "non-consolidated, tax-advantaged vehicle to enhance profitability" of its core products and help in its expansion into finite risk reinsurance.
